description:
Ask the agency for a viewing of a listing the person has already enquired about (with submit_enquiry,
or on PropertyList, in the last 30 days), with the times that suit them. Identify the person by the
email or phone they gave in that enquiry. Requires consent: true, on the same terms as the enquiry
(get_enquiry_consent); never set it on their behalf. The agency sees the request on the enquiry and
replies to the person directly to confirm a time. Asking again with new times replaces the earlier
times. If there is no enquiry yet, use submit_enquiry with preferred_viewing_times instead.

consent.description: Required, true: the person agreed to the consent_text from get_enquiry_consent.

email.description: The email the person gave in their enquiry. An email or a phone is required.

phone.description: The phone the person gave in their enquiry, when they gave one.

preferred_times.description: When they would like to view it, in their words or as dates (e.g. 'Saturday morning', '2026-11-14 10:00', 'any weekday after 5pm').

name: request_viewing

viewing_date.description: The date read from preferred_times (YYYY-MM-DD), when one was.

title: Request a viewing
